objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-unusual-filezilla-xml-config-access
objects.description: The following analytic identifies processes accessing FileZilla XML config files such as recentservers.xml and sitemanager.xml. It leverages Windows Security Event logs, specifically monitoring EventCode 4663, which tracks object access events. This activity is significant because it can indicate unauthorized access or manipulation of sensitive configuration files used by FileZilla, a popular FTP client.
